package domain_test

import (
	"testing"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
)

func TestTeacherDialogBindingContextShape(t *testing.T) {
	base := domain.TeacherDialogBinding{
		ID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", StudentID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444",
		PersonalTeacherID: "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555", ContextType: domain.LearningContextGeneral,
	}
	_, err := domain.NewTeacherDialogBinding(base)
	require.NoError(t, err)

	base.ContextType = domain.LearningContextLesson
	_, err = domain.NewTeacherDialogBinding(base)
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, domain.ErrInvalidDialogContext)
	base.ContextID = "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666"
	_, err = domain.NewTeacherDialogBinding(base)
	require.NoError(t, err)
}
